note: Aquatic Marisa's own hat (not shared with the land Marisa): worn on the head and set down brim up as her boat. Hat units are the land hat's model units; the game draws the hat at scale (hat_vessel.json scale.aquatic_marisa) in every form. All candidates share the brim and the crown base so only the crown, and so the hollow afloat, differs.

brim.note: round; its diameter is the land brim's side-to-side width (20.26), so the hat reads the same 1.4x width from the front. Worn, the outer brim droops; set down the same cloth turns up into a raised rim round the owner (EH22-001)

freeboard_note: afloat the brim face that sat on the head is up, this far over the water (as hat_vessel.json bowl.freeboard)

portion.note: a stored portion keeps the room it takes now (a floor circle of radius 0.09 and 0.06 high, AQUATIC_MARISA_IMPLEMENTATION storage); the layer is that volume spread level over the hollow
portion.fills_note: 24 portions is the whole load limit 12 at 0.5 a portion with no young aboard
